title: Native element.fit_marked for cylinders, project restore and CLI fit-cylinder
scope: The cylinder branch of element.fit_marked in the native engine: draft hint, assumed diameter, orient (axis), extend (start/end), describeElement, discard text, per-kind counters and one history step; marked-cylinder recipes refitted on project.load; CLI fit-cylinder. acceptance: Original and Rust command results and full store state after every step are byte-identical on fixed tube meshes (closed, noisy, tilted, partial arc, flat refusal, 1,600-point refusal) across sigma, units, assumed, orient, extend, name, box, undo/redo; a wrong radius fails the comparison.
open_items: pinned_native_cylinder_comparison: 45/45 byte-identical (results and full stores after every step), fixtures/native-cylinder/generate.py, oracle branch cyl- in oracle/scan-session-owned.mjs. Wrong values fail it: radius x(1+1e-9) and the nextId store canary (SCANRULER_NATIVE_CYLINDER_CANARY) both turn all 45 red.
Plane regressions after switching orient to js_atan2 and fixing the discard count's thousands separator: native plane 212/212 and M3d project 23/23 still pass.
saved_cylinder_reopens_unchanged: an assumed/oriented/extended cylinder saves and reloads to identical element state (plain test; no oracle project trace for cylinders yet).
